rationale: Many reviews exist and disagree, they share most of their primary studies (c3), and most deserve low confidence (c4), so another pooled analysis of primary studies would repeat their problems within the time available. An umbrella review with a citation matrix, confidence ratings for each review and outcomes chosen for the triage decision (false reassurance first, c2; accuracy at thresholds, c1; false alarms as the cost to other patients) answers the medical director's question. Reporting follows PRIOR.
alternatives: New pooled analysis of primary accuracy studies (refused: duplicates the overlapping evidence and exceeds the fellow's time)
Local accuracy study at triage (refused for now: needs a reference diagnosis protocol and ethics review; may follow)
Adopt the regional consensus statement unchanged (refused: its basis is reviews of low confidence that the umbrella review will rate)
guidelines: Citation matrix with corrected covered area
whyNotMoreComplex: Re-analysing primary studies or collecting local data would be slower and would not remove the definitional disagreements the umbrella review can expose.

decision.statement: Conduct an umbrella review of reviews of point-of-care lactate at emergency department triage for adults with suspected sepsis, reporting false reassurance as the primary outcome, accuracy at 2 and 4 mmol/L, and false alarms as a balancing outcome, with overlap correction and a confidence rating for each review, before the May 2027 pathway revision.
decision.question: Should the department base its triage lactate rule on an umbrella review of the existing reviews?

criteria.text: Reviews disagree, overlap heavily and are mostly of low confidence, and the triage-relevant errors can be derived from their reported accuracy.
A high-confidence umbrella review answering the triage question already exists.

gates.requirement: Librarian support to design and run the searches
gates.evidence: Library request LIB-2026-311, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Confirmation that a review of published literature needs no ethics review
gates.evidence: Research office reference RO-2026-0907 dated 2026-09-11, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Adopt the regional consensus statement unchanged
Local accuracy study at triage later
decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c4 from retrieved records and on two investigator-supplied confirmations.

summary: Umbrella review recommended; the decision rests on four ledger claims and both gates are met.
